Report on NATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS DAY-2025

Heads of the all departments are hereby informed to ensure that, Human Rights Day is duly observed in your respective departments on 10th December-2025 at ll. 15AM. You are advised to instruct your department faculty members to address students on the importance of observance of Human Rights Day and its relevance in promoting Universal values such as equality, dignity, and freedom Administer the Human Rights Day Pledge in all classrooms during regular class hours. Submit a report on the observance, along with photographs to the event coordinator Mr.Chandrashekar.C.facuItyBSH.
